head: Nuke Keyboard: new iPhone keyboard app with on-device dictation
dek: Nuke Keyboard is a $4.99 iPhone keyboard with autocorrect, grammar fixes and dictation that run on the phone. It came out on 25 November and was #96 in paid Utilities on the US App Store on 26 November.
details: The listing names wider key reach, adjustable haptic and sound feedback, saved phrases you add with one tap, a full emoji panel and a number pad. It can fix grammar and show each change word by word, and rewrite a sentence shorter, friendlier or more formal. Cloud proofreading is optional and only works with your own AI model and key. It needs iOS 26 and is made by Sean Kelly.
means: If you want a different keyboard on your iPhone that keeps your typing on the phone, this is a new paid option. Some extra features need Full Access.
todo: After buying, add it in Settings, General, Keyboard, Keyboards, Add New Keyboard, then hold the globe key to switch to it.
